title: publication_live_control_receipt.v1
description: One observation of a live repository control, consumed by `cargo xtask publication-sync plan` as evidence that a `publication_sync_manifest.v1` live control is proven (#7972, controller #6356). This is the contract the planner requires; a producer that queries the live control plane must satisfy it (#14576). Until such a producer exists, no live control can legitimately be marked proven — which is the intended fail-closed state, not a gap to route around. A digest binds bytes; this document binds meaning.

control.description: The exact control this observation covers. The planner requires this to equal the control the manifest cites it for, so a receipt cannot be reused across controls.

repository.description: The repository whose live control plane was observed. Must equal the manifest's publication_repository.

release.description: The release this observation was taken for. Must equal the manifest's release.

result.description: The observed disposition, in the same vocabulary the manifest uses for a live control. Only `proven` can prove a control.

observed_at.description: UTC date the live control plane was actually queried (YYYY-MM-DD). Freshness is judged against the manifest's planned_at, never against wall-clock now, so planning stays deterministic.

observation_method.description: How the control plane was queried, for example a named API call or workflow.

observation_authority.description: Who or what performed the observation and under whose authority.

observed_state.description: The state that was actually seen. Free-form by control, but required to be present: a receipt that records no state is not an observation.
